places.name: Abbey Falls
places.description: Coorg's most dramatic and accessible waterfall, framed by the coffee plantations that define the region.
places.bestTime: July to January for maximum volume and lush surroundings

places.name: Raja's Seat, Madikeri
places.description: Madikeri's signature sunset viewpoint, historically the leisure garden of Coorg's royal family.
places.bestTime: Sunset, October to February for clear skies

places.name: Namdroling Monastery (Golden Temple), Bylakuppe
places.description: The largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in South India, whose Golden Temple rivals those in Lhasa for richness of decoration.
places.mapsSearch: Namdroling Monastery Golden Temple Bylakuppe Coorg
places.bestTime: October to March; spectacular during Tibetan New Year (Losar) in Feb–Mar

places.name: Talacauvery
places.description: The sacred origin of the Kaveri River — one of Hinduism's holiest sites and a centre of pilgrimage for 2,000 years.
places.bestTime: October for the Kaveri Sankramana festival; year-round for the trek to Brahmagiri summit

places.name: Brahmagiri Wildlife Sanctuary
places.description: Core Nilgiri Biosphere tiger habitat with arguably the most diverse forest ecology in the entire Western Ghats.

places.name: Madikeri Fort
places.description: The only fort in India where a Hindu temple and a Christian church stand inside the same compound, reflecting Coorg's unique history.

places.name: Dubare Elephant Camp
places.description: The most accessible and ethical elephant interaction experience in South India, managed by the forest department.
places.bestTime: Morning (6–9 AM) for bathing and feeding session

places.name: Coffee Estate Walk, Coorg
places.description: India's premier coffee-growing region — walking through a harvest-season estate engages all five senses at once.
places.bestTime: October to January for harvest; April to May for blooming (white, jasmine-like flowers)

places.name: Nagarhole National Park (Rajiv Gandhi NP)
places.description: One of India's highest-density tiger and leopard reserves with excellent safari infrastructure and near-daily big cat sightings.
places.mapsSearch: Nagarhole National Park Coorg Karnataka safari
places.bestTime: October to May; evening safaris during October-February for best light

places.name: Iruppu Falls
places.description: The tallest and most dramatic waterfall in the Coorg region, set in a forest wildlife corridor with both religious and natural significance.

budget.label: Budget
budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
